fw=$(curl -sf --max-time 5 --unix-socket "$HOME/.crc/crc-http.sock" http://localhost/network/services/forwarder/all) || exit 1
for l in $(printf '%s' "$fw" | jq -r '.[] | select(.protocol == "tcp") | .local | select(test("^127[.]0[.]0[.]1:3[0-9]{4}$"))'); do
  curl -sf --max-time 5 --unix-socket "$HOME/.crc/crc-http.sock" -X POST http://localhost/network/services/forwarder/unexpose -d "{\"local\":\"$l\",\"protocol\":\"tcp\"}" || exit 1
  echo "removed workstation forward $l"
done
